info.name: Login.gov OpenID Connect Authentication Authorization API

params.name: response_type
params.description: Must be `code`. Implicit flow is not supported.

params.name: scope
params.description: Space-separated list of requested scopes. Must include `openid`.

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: Pre-registered redirect URI. Must match exactly.

params.name: nonce
params.description: Random string (minimum 22 characters) bound to the id_token to prevent replay.

params.name: state
params.description: Opaque value (minimum 22 characters) returned with the callback for CSRF protection and request/callback correlation.

params.name: acr_values
params.description: Requested authentication context. Combines a service level and an authenticator assurance level.

params.name: code_challenge
params.description: PKCE code challenge (base64url SHA-256 of `code_verifier`). Required for native apps using PKCE instead of private_key_jwt.

items.docs:
Begins the OIDC authorization code flow. The user is redirected to Login.gov, authenticates,
consents to the requested scopes, and is redirected back to `redirect_uri` with an
authorization `code` and the original `state` value.
